before.name: India — Reserve Bank of India careers
before.authority: Reserve Bank of India — Services Board and Human Resource Management
before.notes: Official RBI Grade B notice dated 29 April 2026, panel year 2026, describes direct recruitment on probation: initially two years, extendable to four. Original window closed 20 May at 18:00; governing timezone unverified. It permits Indian citizens, subjects of Nepal/Bhutan and specified Tibetan-refugee/Indian-origin migration categories. Required Government of India eligibility certificate can remain pending at examination admission but must be issued before appointment offer. This is restricted-category eligibility, not permission for every foreign citizen. Assistant panel year 2025 was advertised 16 February 2026. Its preliminary/main selection includes English tests and mandatory state official/local-language proficiency test, without exemption or CEFR equivalence. These are separate cycles; edit notices and exam cities do not create new intakes.
before.accessGap: Browser-read HTML research awaiting review; reader returned human-verification pages. No CAPTCHA solved, raw originals retained, adapter accepted or cycle published. Grade B language appendices and Assistant office-language mapping PDF inaccessible to reader and not accepted. Assistant original March window and tentative examination dates must be reconciled with linked corrigendum/April notices before publication. Full nationality category definitions, age, qualification equivalence, attempts, reservation conditions and official timezone require review. Online examinations occur at allocated centres, not assumed remote-from-home tests. National scope has no state tags inferred from examination cities. Complete RBI and other-pathway coverage unverified.
before.licence: Official public-authority reader-only discovery. Original notices, collection terms, translations and extracted summaries require review before connector acceptance or publication.
